title: Sealed OpenRappter Bar first-launch bootstrap pins
$comment: The native lifecycle owner must prefer VerifiedRuntimeInstaller.preferredNodeExecutable(forProjectPath: ProcessManager.resolveProjectPath()) before legacy/system Node lookup. It only returns the verified Node when the selected project resolves to the matching installed runtime. Do not mutate global PATH or install floating npm packages.
description: Generate runtime-bootstrap.json before signing the Bar. Copy it and verified-runtime-bootstrap.mjs to Contents/Resources and set Info.plist OpenRappterSourceCommit. Build both dependency-complete runtime archives before signing; include their exact bytes in the canonical candidate. After the Release Constitution check, publish the existing openrappter-bar-cask-proposal/v1 frozen receipt proof as runtime-bootstrap-proof.json on this exact Bar release. The proof is data, not executable bootstrap code, and need not be embedded in its own candidate.

approval_url.description: Must name this metadata's exact Bar version. The helper validates all four frozen authority receipts and manifests, including predecessor hashes and chronological order; it never follows main or a package dist-tag.

helper_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the sealed verified-runtime-bootstrap.mjs resource. Swift verifies the resource seal and this digest before executing its snapshot.

version.description: Node 24 or later, exactly the version/ABI used to assemble this variant. No system Node is required or assumed.

file.description: A flat candidate file recorded in provenance.json and SHA256SUMS. Its tar uses one runtime/ root, includes package.json, dist, UI and all production node_modules/native dependencies for the pinned Node architecture/ABI. Use regular files/directories and contained links; no special or sparse members. No npm install/build runs on the customer's machine.
